reference_limits: All references are dated N049 observations, not a live feed, final pregame price or executable order.

Current references can postdate individual model issues and are not causal issue inputs or paired forecast metrics.
The completed JAX/BAL event receives no new current-pregame reference; historical references retain their own clocks.
No previous-version or alternate-horizon record fills a missing current-source cell.
performance_claim: No new prospective performance, model promotion, calibrated coverage or profitable strategy is established.
